title: Jumps and signs — the complete MNX navigation vocabulary
description: Every navigation marking MNX v17 defines, one per bar: a segno (default glyph), a segno with a SMuFL glyph override (segnoSerpent2), a 'fine' at end-of-bar, and both jump types — 'segno' (renders D.S.) and 'dsalfine' (renders D.S. al Fine). This IS the whole vocabulary: the jump-type enum has only those two values, and the spec currently has no coda, no D.C., and no 'To Coda' objects (the segno glyph override is the only customization point) — a standards gap worth tracking against future MNX revisions.
